title: tdh.util.framedCanvas
description: `tdh.util.framedCanvas` is an autosized graph-on-parent abstraction that creates a movable, filled canvas outlined in a second color, useful for visually grouping areas of a Pd patch. It is best instantiated with width, height, border-color preset, fill-color preset, and an optional label; argument settings persist when the patch is reopened, whereas properties changed by messages do not.
